name: American Legion Michigan Boys State
city: Hillsdale, MI (Hillsdale College); office in Lansing
what_you_do: Spend a week in a model Michigan state government. Citizens are split into two parties, hold city, county and state elections, and learn how state government works. It is for rising seniors.
who_can_apply: Males who have finished junior year and have at least one semester of high school left. You should like government and show leadership, character and school or community service. You must be a U.S. citizen. You cannot attend Boys State twice.
pay_detail: $25 application fee paid by the student. The $400 program fee is paid by a sponsor such as a local American Legion Post or other community group (2026 brochure).
deadline_text: 2027 session: June 20 to 26, 2027 at Hillsdale College. The home page says 2027 applications are coming soon, with no dates. The 2026 deadline was June 1, 2026.
how_to_apply: The program home page says 2027 applications are coming soon. Use its form to ask for more information. In 2026 you paid a $25 application fee and found a sponsor for the $400 program fee. Office: (517) 371-4720 ext. 123 (site) or 517-220-2754 (brochure), legion@michiganlegion.org.
notes: Not a job. Fees and the June 1 deadline are from the 2026 brochure and flyer, so confirm the 2027 details with the office. The resources page still showed a May 1, 2024 deadline, so it is out of date. Office address: 212 N. Verlinden Ave., Lansing, MI 48915.
